description: This file defines data structures, function pointers, and interfaces related to PostScript font auxiliary functions within the FreeType project. It includes definitions for tables, tokens, fields, parsers, glyph builders, decoders, character maps, and auxiliary services used in font processing.

classes.name: PS_TableRec
classes.description: Represents a table storing an array of objects in a contiguous memory block.

classes.name: T1_TokenRec
classes.description: Represents a token identified during parsing, with start and limit pointers and a token type.

classes.name: T1_FieldRec
classes.description: Models a field within a font object, including its identifier, type, location, and parsing details.

classes.name: PS_ParserRec
classes.description: Encapsulates the state and functions for parsing PostScript font data.

classes.name: T1_BuilderRec
classes.description: Stores outline data during glyph loading, including scale, position, and function pointers for outline construction.

classes.name: T1_DecoderRec
classes.description: Handles decoding of Type 1 font charstrings, including stack, zones, and subroutines.

classes.name: T1_CMap_ClassesRec
classes.description: Defines character map classes for different encoding schemes.

classes.name: PSAux_ServiceRec
classes.description: Provides function pointers and interfaces for auxiliary font processing services.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes various structures such as tables, parsers, builders, and decoders.

methods.name: done
methods.description: Finalizes and releases resources for structures like tables, parsers, builders, and decoders.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds objects to tables within the font processing context.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases table data and cleans up.

methods.name: t1_decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts font data buffers using a seed.
